articles.summary: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) has become a critical tool for monitoring and protecting infrastructure at scale. As deployments have grown, so too have the expectations to move beyond simple detection toward higher accuracy, better event identification, and fewer false alarms. This evolution has driven the adoption of phase‑based DAS, such as VIAVI’s patented true‑phase DAS, as the next step in DAS technology.Rather than replacing existing DAS approaches, phase‑based DAS builds on them and enables more precise, quantitative insight that drives new applications and more confident operational decisions.
